headline: Gazipur: Mother poisons 2 children, attempts suicide after dispute
summary: Two children, aged 2 and 4, are in critical condition after their mother allegedly fed them poison following a family dispute in Sreepur.
details: A woman allegedly poisoned her two children and attempted to take her own life in Tepirbari village, Sreepur upazila, Gazipur, following a domestic dispute.
The woman, identified as Moni Akter, 30, allegedly fed poison to her children, Arafat (4) and Maisha (2), before consuming pesticide herself.
The incident came to light when the children's father, Mobarak Hossain, returned home from his garment factory job and found his family lying on the floor in distress.
Neighbors rushed the three victims to the Sreepur Upazila Health Complex after hearing the father's cries for help.
According to Dr Balram Das of the health complex, all three were brought to the hospital in critical condition.
Due to the rapid deterioration of the children's health, they have been referred to Mymensingh Medical College Hospital for specialized treatment.
Sreepur Upazila Health and Family Planning Officer Dr Shafiqul Islam confirmed the incident to The Daily Star.

headline: Gold prices rise: 22k gold up by 2,216 taka per bhori
summary: The price of 22-carat gold has reached 224,182 taka per bhori following a price hike on Friday morning.
details: Gold and silver prices increased on Friday morning, according to a press release from the Jewelers Association. The price of 22-carat gold rose by 2,216 taka per bhori, bringing the new price to 224,182 taka.
The Association stated that the price hike was driven by an increase in the cost of pure gold and silver in the domestic market, despite a slight dip in global gold prices after an initial rise.

Other gold categories also saw increases: 21-carat gold rose by 2,009 taka to 214,903 taka, 18-carat gold increased by 1,808 taka to 183,883 taka, and traditional gold rose by 1,458 taka to 150,232 taka.
Silver prices also climbed, with 22-carat silver increasing by 117 taka to 4,723 taka and 21-carat silver rising by 175 taka to 4,548 taka per bhori.

Regarding taxes, the Association noted that VAT is already included in the gold prices. For the 2026-27 fiscal year budget, VAT on gold jewelry has been set at 2,500 taka per bhori, down from the previous 5% of the total price.
caption:
Gold prices are climbing again. 22k gold has jumped by 2,216 taka per bhori today.

Gold and silver prices increased on Friday morning, according to a press release from the Jewelers Association. The price of 22-carat gold rose by 2,216 taka per bhori, bringing the new price to 224,182 taka.

The Association stated that the price hike was driven by an increase in the cost of pure gold and silver in the domestic market, despite a slight dip in global gold prices after an initial rise.

Other gold categories also saw increases: 21-carat gold rose by 2,009 taka to 214,903 taka, 18-carat gold increased by 1,808 taka to 183,883 taka, and traditional gold rose by 1,458 taka to 150,232 taka.

Silver prices also climbed, with 22-carat silver increasing by 117 taka to 4,723 taka and 21-carat silver rising by 175 taka to 4,548 taka per bhori.

Regarding taxes, the Association noted that VAT is already included in the gold prices. For the 2026-27 fiscal year budget, VAT on gold jewelry has been set at 2,500 taka per bhori, down from the previous 5% of the total price.
